# comm

Compare two sorted text files through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/comm first.txt second.txt

moonx cli/comm -12 first.txt second.txt
```

Print three columns: records unique to the first file, unique to the second, and shared. -1, -2 and -3 suppress the corresponding columns.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-1` | Suppress lines unique to the first input. |
| `-2` | Suppress lines unique to the second input. |
| `-3` | Suppress lines common to both inputs. |
| `--output-delimiter VALUE` | Separate columns with STR (empty means NUL). |
| `--total` | Print counts for all three columns and a total label. |
| `-h`, `--help` | Show help. |
| `--check-order` | Diagnose unsorted input. |
| `--nocheck-order` | Do not diagnose unsorted input. |
| `-z`, `--zero-terminated` | End records with NUL instead of newline. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

- C and C.UTF-8 use the same unsigned byte ordering, including for malformed UTF-8. Supply both files in that order.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
